---
title: "Exercise. From wide to long with Gapminder (solutions)"
format: html
---

**Question:** How did life expectancy change in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania since 1950?

```{r}
#| label: setup
pacman::p_load(tidyverse)
```

## 1. Look at the wide table

```{r}
#| label: look
# One row per country, one column per year
"https://bit.ly/wide_to_long" |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(name %in% c("Estonia", "Latvia", "Lithuania")) |>
  select(name, `1950`, `1990`, `2023`)
```

**Ask:** How many variables does this table have? Where is the year?

## 2. Make it long

```{r}
#| label: pivot
# select() keeps the country and the years 1950 to 2023. cols = the year columns, names_to = new column for the year, values_to = new column for the value
"https://bit.ly/wide_to_long" |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(name %in% c("Estonia", "Latvia", "Lithuania")) |>
  select(name, `1950`:`2023`) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `1950`:`2023`,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "life_exp",
    names_transform = as.integer
  )
```

**Ask:** How many rows now? Which three columns matter?

## 3. Plot it

```{r}
#| label: plot
# Years after 2023 are projections, so the table stops at 2023
"https://bit.ly/wide_to_long" |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(name %in% c("Estonia", "Latvia", "Lithuania")) |>
  select(name, `1950`:`2023`) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `1950`:`2023`,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "life_exp",
    names_transform = as.integer
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = life_exp, color = name)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Life expectancy (years)", color = NULL)
```

## 4. Your turn

Pick three other countries. Change the names in `filter()`. Write one sentence about what you see.

```{r}
#| label: your-turn
"https://bit.ly/wide_to_long" |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(name %in% c("Chile", "Poland", "Sweden")) |>
  select(name, `1950`:`2023`) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `1950`:`2023`,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "life_exp",
    names_transform = as.integer
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = life_exp, color = name)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Life expectancy (years)", color = NULL)
```

Sentence: [YOUR SENTENCE HERE]

## 5. One more question

In which year was Latvia's life expectancy lowest since 1950?

```{r}
#| label: lowest
"https://bit.ly/wide_to_long" |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(name == "Latvia") |>
  select(name, `1950`:`2023`) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `1950`:`2023`,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "life_exp",
    names_transform = as.integer
  ) |>
  arrange(life_exp) |>
  slice(1)
```
